layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Herbivore diet symbolism
features: A charming collection of prehistoric plant foods made from colorful clay
A fan-shaped bright green Ginkgo leaf with a smooth surface
A textured brown pine cone with rounded clay scales
A cluster of thin green pine needles and a soft fern frond
A feathered Cycad leaf and a small bunch of round purple berries
All items have a soft, toy-like appearance with rounded edges
layer_3_action.action: A centered, eye-level group shot of various clay prehistoric plants arranged neatly on a neutral clay surface. The lighting is soft and professional, highlighting the different textures of the clay foliage. This serves as a symbolic 'buffet' to represent an herbivorous diet. No text.
